description: This file provides a dependency for FastAPI that retrieves the current authenticated user based on a JWT token. It implements the get_current_user function which decodes the token, validates it, and fetches the user from the database.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model representing user data in the database.

methods.name: User get_current_user(db: Session = Depends(get_db), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
methods.description: Retrieves the currently authenticated user from a JWT Bearer token, raising HTTP exceptions if validation fails.

ctags.name: get_current_user
ctags.pattern: /^def get_current_user(db: Session = Depends(get_db), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme)) -> User/
